R.DEVDAS J., (ORAL):
Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo dated 11.08.2023 stating that the contesting parties have settled the matter out of Court in a Civil Suit and therefore,
the petitioner does not wish to purse the matter.
2. The memo is taken on record subject to all just exceptions.
Accordingly, the writ petition stands dismissed as withdrawn.
